subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------ALT.FT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 450 (MP(I)-24). INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the subject; ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information), CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) and POL-P (political policies). From MT-INFO: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From CULT-INFO-B: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From POL-P: SOC-RT (social reality) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From WO-EXP-PRI: TR-INFO (trans-information). From VT-PLT: VT-SY. From PROG-CONT: T-P (time presence). From T-P: RT-DY (reality dynamics).
